import requests

cid = 29430
summary_url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug_view/data/compound/{cid}/JSON"
resp = requests.get(summary_url)
data = resp.json()

# Look for record title, description, or common name sections
record = data.get('Record', {})
print("Record Title:", record.get('RecordTitle'))

def search_sections(sections):
    for sec in sections:
        heading = sec.get('TOCHeading', '')
        if any(w in heading.lower() for w in ['name', 'description', 'synonym']):
            print(f"Heading: {heading}")
            if 'Information' in sec:
                for info in sec['Information']:
                    desc = info.get('Description')
                    val = info.get('Value')
                    if desc or val:
                        print(f"  Info desc: {desc}, val: {str(val)[:100]}")
        if 'Section' in sec:
            search_sections(sec['Section'])

search_sections(record.get('Section', []))
